title: GTCC Ontology-Driven Digital Twin: Supporting Computational Artifacts
description: Corrected EKLM simulation artifacts: 72 paired routing cases, 104 engineering-contract cases, 36 evidence-lifecycle checks, 95 diagnostic threshold checks, six matched graph/conventional queries, and 583 physical replay records. Independent conventional validation control; no field-accuracy or representation-specific superiority claim. Historical 55-case records unavailable. Code MIT; author-created data/prose CC BY 4.0.
